name: Anthropic Search
description: Web search through Claude's server-side web_search tool

webSearch.apiKey.label: Anthropic API Key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Optional. Leave empty to reuse the Anthropic provider's API key (an auth profile or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

webSearch.model.label: Search Model
webSearch.model.help: Claude model that runs the search and writes the cited answer (default: the agent's main model when it is an anthropic/ model, else claude-opus-5-5).

webSearch.maxUses.label: Max Searches
webSearch.maxUses.help: Most searches Claude may run for one web_search call (default: 5). Each search is billed separately.

webSearch.effort.label: Effort
webSearch.effort.help: Optional output_config.effort for the search call: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max.
